entries.en: Please!
entries.zh: 求你了！

entries.en: Stop!
entries.zh: 住手！

entries.en: No!
entries.zh: 不！

entries.en: Please!
entries.zh: 求你了！

entries.en: Wait, I mean you no harm.
entries.zh: 等等，我没有恶意。

entries.en: Leave me alone!
entries.zh: 别来烦我！

entries.en: Go away!
entries.zh: 走开！

entries.en: Let me be!

entries.en: You attacked me!
entries.zh: 你刚才攻击我！

entries.en: Sorry, I'm confused.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我脑子很乱。

entries.en: Forgive me, I don't know what came over me.
entries.zh: 原谅我，我不知道刚才是怎么了。

entries.en: What's wrong with you?
entries.zh: 你有什么毛病？

entries.en: I don't know, I don't remember much.
entries.zh: 我不知道，我记不起多少事。

entries.en: Nothing. Just confused. Where are we?
entries.zh: 没什么，只是很迷糊。这是哪里？

entries.en:
We're under ground. I was thrown down by bandits.
Reckon you did too and hit your head.
entries.zh:
我们在地下。我被强盗扔下来了。
估计你也一样，还撞到了头。

entries.en: Why would they do that?
entries.zh: 他们为什么要这么做？

entries.en: I'm guessing so I wouldn't tell I'd seen them.
entries.zh: 估计是不想让我说出见过他们的事。

entries.en: I suppose that makes sense.
entries.zh: 这么说倒也合理。

entries.en: That may be so.
entries.zh: 也许是这样。

entries.en: Look, I don't want no trouble. Just let me go.
entries.zh: 听着，我不想惹麻烦。让我走吧。

entries.en: Let's start over. Who are you?
entries.zh: 重新来过吧。你是谁？

entries.en:
I'm Derrin. I'm just a farm hand.
What about you?
entries.zh:
我叫德林，只是个农场帮工。
你呢？

entries.en: I can't remember much at all. You can call me {Actor[1].Name}.
entries.zh: 我几乎什么都想不起来。你可以叫我{Actor[1].Name}。

entries.en: {Actor[1].Name}? I'm not sure even of that.
entries.zh: {Actor[1].Name}？连这个我都不太确定。

entries.en: Hitting your head can make you forget stuff. I've heard.
entries.zh: 撞到头会让人忘事。我听说过。

entries.en: Whatever the case, I must leave this place.
entries.zh: 无论如何，我必须离开这里。

entries.en: We should focus on getting out of here.
entries.zh: 我们还是先想办法出去吧。

entries.en: Can't. The hole is too high to reach.
entries.zh: 出不去。洞口太高，够不着。

entries.en: There's another exit. I'm sure of it.
entries.zh: 一定还有别的出口。我确信如此。

entries.en: Might as well look around. Can't just stay here.
entries.zh: 不如四处找找，总不能一直待在这里。

entries.en: There's dead ones everywhere.
entries.zh: 到处都是死人。

entries.en: I think I can deal with them.
entries.zh: 我想我能对付它们。

entries.en: Well, good luck with that.
entries.zh: 那就祝你好运。

entries.en: You could come with me.
entries.zh: 你可以跟我一起走。

entries.en: I guess I'll be on my way then.
entries.zh: 那我就先走了。

entries.en: Our odds will be better If we go together.
entries.zh: 一起走，活下来的机会更大。

entries.en: They're not much trouble. Just stay clear of them.
entries.zh: 它们不难对付，避开就好了。

entries.en: One of them chased me!
entries.zh: 有一个追过我！

entries.en: Some may need dealing with.
entries.zh: 有些恐怕还是得解决掉。

entries.en: Looks like you got away just fine.
entries.zh: 看起来你逃得挺顺利。

entries.en: I won't stop you. Will you tell me your name before you go?
entries.zh: 我不拦你。走之前能告诉我你的名字吗？

entries.en:
Thank you.
My name is Derrin.
entries.zh:
谢谢。
我叫德林。

entries.en: I will send help for you if I can.
entries.zh: 如果可以，我会找人来救你。

entries.en: Goodbye Derrin.
entries.zh: 再见，德林。

entries.en: I'm no fighter.
entries.zh: 我不会打架。

entries.en: Neither are these undead.
entries.zh: 这些亡者也不会。

entries.en: It doesn't take much. We can look for some weapons.
entries.zh: 用不着多大本事。我们可以找些武器。

entries.en: Nor am I, but the need is upon us.
entries.zh: 我也不会，可眼下别无选择。

entries.en: I will protect you. You'll be safe with me.
entries.zh: 我会保护你。跟着我很安全。

entries.en: I suppose we can try, but if things get bad you're on your own.
entries.zh: 可以试试，可要是情况不妙，你就得靠自己了。

entries.en: Fine. But give us a chance before choosing flight.
entries.zh: 行。不过别急着逃，先试着一起撑住。

entries.en: That's all I ask.
entries.zh: 我只求这样。

entries.en: Alright.
entries.zh: 好吧。

entries.en: Good. Let's go.
entries.zh: 好，走吧。

entries.en: If I can't rely on you, then you're no use to me.
entries.zh: 如果不能指望你，那你对我就毫无用处。

entries.en: Good. I don't want to be.
entries.zh: 很好，我也不想派上用场。

entries.en: So be it.
entries.zh: 那就这样吧。

entries.en: I have no need for you then.
entries.zh: 那我就不需要你了。

entries.en: Good. You'll let me be then?
entries.zh: 那好，你肯放过我了吧？

entries.en: Of course. I wish you luck.
entries.zh: 当然。祝你好运。

entries.en: Do as you wish.
entries.zh: 随你的便。

entries.zh: 我不能放你走。你可能趁我不备攻击我。

entries.zh: 确实有些奇怪。

entries.zh: 幸会，德林。我叫……{Actor[1].Name}，大概吧。

entries.zh: 我似乎记不起以前的事了。

entries.zh: 那些死人怎么办？

entries.en: I'm more concerned about the necromancer.
entries.zh: 我更担心死灵术士。

entries.en: There's a necromancer too?!
entries.zh: 这里还有死灵术士？！

entries.en: If there are undead, there is a necromancer. Close by.
entries.zh: 有亡者，就有死灵术士，而且就在附近。

entries.en: Take me with you, I won't make it on my own!
entries.zh: 带我一起走吧，我一个人活不下去！

entries.en: No, I merely wished to see how you would react.
entries.zh: 不，我只是想看看你有什么反应。

entries.en: I'm not so sure now. Can I come with you?

entries.zh: 它们似乎不怎么主动攻击人，我会尽量避开。

entries.en: One of them chased me. I'll die if I stay here, maybe we can get out together.
entries.zh: 有一个追过我！待在这里会死的，也许我们可以一起出去。

entries.en: If they get in my way, I will kill them.
entries.zh: 谁挡我的路，我就杀了谁。

entries.en: Take me with you!
entries.zh: 带上我！

entries.en: How did you get here? Can you get out?
entries.zh: 你怎么进来的？能出去吗？

entries.en: I don't recall.
entries.zh: 我……记不起来。

entries.en: What? How long have you been here?
entries.zh: 什么？你在这里待多久了？

entries.en: Not long. I'm confused. I can't remember much at all.
entries.zh: 没多久。我很迷糊，几乎什么也记不起来。

entries.en: Reckon you got thrown in like me, hit your noggin. Heard that can forget you stuff.
entries.zh: 估计你跟我一样被扔下来，撞到了脑袋。听说那会让人忘事。

entries.en: Perhaps. I had a note, saying there's a way out, I intend to find it.
entries.zh: 也许吧。我有张字条，说这里有出口，我打算找到它。

entries.en: It doesn't matter, I must leave.
entries.zh: 无所谓了，我必须离开。

entries.en: I certainly intend to.
entries.zh: 我当然是这么打算的。

entries.en: Don't leave me here! I won't make it.
entries.zh: 别把我留在这里！我活不下去的。

entries.en: Yes, we may be able to help each other.
entries.zh: 好，我们或许能互相帮忙。

entries.en: All I've got is this stick though.
entries.zh: 不过我只有这根棍子。

entries.en: Do you intend to make yourself useful?
entries.zh: 你打算帮上点忙吗？

entries.en: I'll do my best. Only got this stick though.
entries.zh: 我会尽力的，可我只有这根棍子。

entries.en: No, you will only slow me down.
entries.zh: 不，你只会拖累我。

entries.en: Please? I'll keep up, I'll do whatever you ask.
entries.zh: 求你了？我会跟上的，你让我做什么都行。

entries.en: I'm sorry. I will try to send help.
entries.zh: 抱歉。我会尽量找人来救你。

entries.en: I'll return for you, if I can.
entries.zh: 如果可以，我会回来接你。

entries.en: Very well, you may follow. But you must take care of yourself.
entries.zh: 好吧，你可以跟着，但得照顾好自己。

entries.en: Are you able to fight?
entries.zh: 你会战斗吗？

entries.en: My Da was a soldier. Tried to teach me some, but I wasn't much for it.
entries.zh: 我爹当过兵，想教过我一些，可我没怎么学进去。

entries.en: What about you?
entries.zh: 你呢？

entries.en: I think I may be able to handle these undead.
entries.zh: 我想我能对付这些亡者。

entries.en: I am quite proficient.
entries.zh: 我很擅长战斗。

entries.en: I must admit I'm quite useless myself.
entries.zh: 不得不承认，我自己也没什么本事。

entries.en: We'll get by. Let's be on our way.
entries.zh: 会有办法的，走吧。

entries.en: I think it best if you stay here after all.
entries.zh: 想了想，你还是待在这里最好。

entries.en: Well, let's be on our way.
entries.zh: 那我们走吧。

entries.en: We should look around. My Da would say just a good shirt can save your skin.
entries.zh: 我们应该四处找找。我爹常说，一件好衬衫都能救命。

entries.en: I suppose. Let me know if you see anything useful. Let's go now.
entries.zh: 也是。看到有用的东西就告诉我。现在走吧。

entries.en: I'd rather focus on getting out, but take what you want.
entries.zh: 我更想专心找出口，不过你想拿什么就拿吧。

entries.en: Don't touch anything unless I say so. Let's be on our way.
entries.zh: 没我的话，什么都别碰。走吧。

entries.en: I've reconsidered. We may able to help each other. Will you come?
entries.zh: 我改变主意了。我们也许能互相帮助，你来吗？

entries.en: Yes. I was thinking to try on my own, but I'm scared If I'm honest.
entries.zh: 来。我本想自己试试，可说实话，我害怕。

entries.en: And it's dark.
entries.zh: 而且这里很黑。

entries.en: Please don't hurt me.
entries.zh: 求你别伤害我。

entries.en: {Actor[0].Name}, I need your help. Please.

entries.en: {Actor[0].Name}, we need to stick together.

entries.en: I think I'll find my own way.
entries.zh: 我想我还是自己找路吧。

entries.zh: 你需要我，{Actor[0].Name}。你一个人活不下去。

entries.en: I know you're upset, but you need my help.
entries.zh: 我知道你很生气，但你需要我的帮助。

entries.en: Drop the façade. I'm the only friend you have here.
entries.zh: 别装了。我是你在这里唯一的朋友。

entries.en: Do you consider me a friend?
entries.zh: 你把我当朋友吗？

entries.en: Of course.
entries.zh: 当然。

entries.en: Under the circumstances.
entries.zh: 在眼下这种处境里，算是吧。

entries.en: I don't know that I'd call you friend.
entries.zh: 我可不知道能不能把你当朋友。

entries.en: But I am. Let us put it behind us and join our efforts.
entries.zh: 但我确实是。让我们放下过去，一起努力吧。

entries.en: You refuse my friendship? Fuck you then.
entries.zh: 不要我这个朋友？那你去你的吧。

entries.en: I had you right.
entries.zh: 果然没看错你。

entries.en: You're mad! Just let me go.
entries.zh: 你疯了！让我走。

entries.en: No! Go away!

entries.en: Just leave me be.
entries.zh: 别再烦我了。

entries.en: Alright. We go together then.

entries.en: I suppose I've got no choice.
entries.zh: 看来我没得选。

entries.en: I think we should part ways.

entries.en: No, {Actor[0].Name}, stay.

entries.en: You won't change my mind.

entries.en: Then leave.

entries.zh: 也许是{Actor[1].Name}，可我真的什么都想不起来。

entries.en: I seem to have no memories. It might be {Actor[1].Name}, but it sounds strange to me.
entries.zh: 我似乎失去了所有记忆。也许叫{Actor[1].Name}，可这个名字听着很陌生。

entries.en:
Sorry, I don't know what came over me.
I need to leave this place.
entries.zh:
抱歉，我不知道刚才是怎么了。
我得离开这里。

entries.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to. I'm very confused.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我不是故意的。我脑子很乱。

entries.en: That's no excuse!
entries.zh: 这不是借口！

entries.en: I know. I won't happen again, I swear it.
entries.zh: 我知道。我发誓不会再这样了。

entries.en: Please, let me be.
entries.zh: 求你了，放过我吧。

entries.en: I will. Best of luck to you Derrin.
entries.zh: 好。祝你好运，德林。

entries.en: And to you.
entries.zh: 你也一样。

entries.en: Come with me Derrin, we can find a way out together.
entries.zh: 跟我走，德林。我们可以一起找出口。

entries.en: With you? No.
entries.zh: 跟你？不。

entries.en: I'm the only ally you have Derrin. You'll die on your own.
entries.zh: 德林，我是你唯一的盟友。独自一人，你会死的。

entries.en: So be it. I wish you luck then.
entries.zh: 那好吧，祝你好运。

entries.en: Good.
entries.zh: 好。

entries.en: You'll regret refusing my help.
entries.zh: 拒绝我的帮助，你会后悔的。

entries.en:
Help?
I don't think so.
entries.zh:
帮助？
我可不这么觉得。

entries.en: You don't understand what I'm going through.
entries.zh: 你根本不明白我正在经历什么。

entries.en: You're scaring me. Please let me be.
entries.zh: 你吓到我了。求你别管我了。

entries.en: Sorry, I will leave you alone.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我不打扰你了。

entries.en: Help me. Together we can escape.
entries.zh: 帮帮我，我们能一起逃出去。

entries.en: Please. I don't want no trouble.
entries.zh: 求你了，我不想惹麻烦。

entries.en:
I won't harm you.
Who are you?
entries.zh:
我不会伤害你。
你是谁？

entries.en:
Me neither.
Who are you?
entries.zh:
我也没有恶意。
你是谁？

entries.en: I mean you no harm. I'm just confused, I don't remember anything.
entries.zh: 我没有恶意，只是很迷糊，什么也不记得。

entries.en: What's your name?
entries.zh: 你叫什么名字？

entries.en: I don't remember even that, I think it may be {Actor[1].Name}.
entries.zh: 连这个都记不起了。我想也许叫{Actor[1].Name}。

entries.en: {Actor[1].Name} perhaps? It sounds strange to me now.
entries.zh: 也许是{Actor[1].Name}？现在听着很陌生。

entries.en: No trouble, I just want to leave.
entries.zh: 我不惹麻烦，只想离开。

entries.en: I need to get out of here.
entries.zh: 我得离开这里。

entries.en: Me neither. Let us join forces and find a way out.
entries.zh: 我也一样。我们联手找出路吧。

entries.en: Leave me alone!
entries.zh: 别来烦我！

entries.en: Let me be!
entries.zh: 放过我吧！

entries.en: Get away from me!
entries.zh: 离我远点！

entries.en: Reckon you got thrown in like me, hit your noggin. Heard that can forget you stuff.
entries.zh: 估计你跟我一样被扔下来，撞到了脑袋。听说那会让人忘事。

entries.en: Thrown in?
entries.zh: 被扔进来？

entries.en: By bandits. They robbed me and threw me down a hole in the ground.
entries.zh: 强盗干的。他们抢了我，把我扔进地上的一个洞里。

entries.en: That seems odd. Why would they do that?
entries.zh: 有点奇怪。他们为什么这么做？

entries.en: I don't know, probably didn't want me telling on them.
entries.zh: 不知道，大概不想让我告发他们。

entries.en: I suppose that makes sense. I wonder if they knew what's down here.
entries.zh: 这么说倒也合理。不知道他们是否清楚下面有什么。

entries.en: Reckon they got some idea.
entries.zh: 估计多少知道一些。

entries.en: We'll need to be watchful of them when we leave.
entries.zh: 出去的时候得提防他们。

entries.en: It seems needlessly cruel.
entries.zh: 没必要这么残忍吧。

entries.en: I didn't do nothing!
entries.zh: 我什么也没干！

entries.en: I wasn't suggesting you did. Now I'm not so sure.
entries.zh: 我没说你干了什么，不过现在不太确定了。

entries.en: I didn't!
entries.zh: 我真没有！

entries.en: Well, they probably didn't expect us to make it out alive, but I'll prove them wrong.
entries.zh: 他们大概没指望我们活着出去，可我要让他们知道自己错了。

entries.en: No matter. I'll be leaving now.
entries.zh: 算了，我要走了。

entries.en: Perhaps they had other reasons. What is this place?
entries.zh: 或许还有别的原因。这是什么地方？

entries.en: I don't know. I don't like it.
entries.zh: 不知道，反正我不喜欢。

entries.en: Well, time to find a way out.
entries.zh: 好了，该找出口了。

entries.en: I'm going to have a look around.
entries.zh: 我要四处看看。

entries.en: What about the dead ones?
entries.zh: 那些死人怎么办？

entries.en: Why not just kill you?
entries.zh: 为什么不直接杀了你？

entries.en: What!? Why?
entries.zh: 什么！？为什么？

entries.en: It's just a strange thing to do. I wonder if there's more to it.
entries.zh: 这种做法很奇怪，不知道是不是另有隐情。

entries.en: There's others here. They're dead, but like, still alive.
entries.zh: 这里还有别人。他们死了，却又像是活着。

entries.en: Clearly they wanted to be rid of you, perhaps they didn't have the stomach for it.
entries.zh: 显然他们想除掉你，只是可能下不了手。

entries.en: Good thing they didn't then.
entries.zh: 那幸好他们没下手。

entries.en: That is if you can make it out alive.
entries.zh: 那也得你能活着出去才行。

entries.en: Well, I don't plan on staying here much longer.
entries.zh: 反正我不打算在这里多待了。

entries.en: In the ground? Where are we?
entries.zh: 地下？我们到底在哪里？

entries.en: That's all I know. This place is scary.
entries.zh: 我只知道这些。这地方太吓人了。

entries.en: Well, let's get out of here.
entries.zh: 那我们出去吧。

entries.en: I must leave.
entries.zh: 我必须离开。

entries.en:
Perhaps.
What is this place?
entries.zh:
也许吧。
这是什么地方？

entries.en: All I know is I came through a hole in the ground.
entries.zh: 我只知道自己是从地上的一个洞进来的。

entries.en: So we're under ground? We should leave.
entries.zh: 所以我们在地下？应该离开这里。

entries.en: I need to get out of here.
entries.zh: 我得离开这里。

entries.en: My name is Derrin. I'm just a farm hand.
entries.zh: 我叫德林，只是个农场帮工。

entries.en: Derrin. I'm {Actor[1].Name}, I think.
entries.zh: 德林。我叫……{Actor[1].Name}，大概吧。

entries.en: You think?
entries.zh: 大概？

entries.en: I'm afraid I don't remember much.
entries.zh: 恐怕我记不起多少事。

entries.en:
Well Derrin, I'm not sure I even remember my own name.
But you can call me {Actor[1].Name}.
entries.zh:
德林，我好像连自己的名字都记不清了。
不过你可以叫我{Actor[1].Name}。

entries.en:
If you got thrown in like me, you maybe hit your noggin.
That can forget you stuff.
entries.zh:
如果你也像我一样被扔下来，可能撞到了脑袋。
那会让人忘事。

entries.en: Thrown in where?
entries.zh: 被扔进哪里？

entries.en: A hole in the ground. That's where we are.
entries.zh: 地上的一个洞。我们就在这里。

entries.en: And who threw you in the hole?
entries.zh: 是谁把你扔进洞里的？

entries.en: Well, we should leave.
entries.zh: 那我们该走了。

entries.en: Who threw you in?
entries.zh: 谁把你扔进来的？

entries.en:
That may well be.
We should leave this place.
entries.zh:
很可能是这样。
我们应该离开这里。

entries.en: Can't. Hole is too high to reach.
entries.zh: 出不去，洞口太高，够不着。

entries.en: There must be another way out. I'm sure of it.
entries.zh: 一定还有别的出路，我确信如此。

entries.en: There's dead ones everywhere.
entries.zh: 到处都是死人。

entries.en: Can't just stay here, we should look around.
entries.zh: 总不能一直待在这里，我们应该四处找找。

entries.en: There's dead ones everywhere. It's too dangerous.
entries.zh: 到处都是死人，太危险了。

entries.en: Well, I will look for another exit.
entries.zh: 那我就去找别的出口。

entries.en: Good luck then.
entries.zh: 那祝你好运。

entries.en: Good luck to you.
entries.zh: 祝你好运。

entries.en: Come with me.
entries.zh: 跟我走。

entries.en: There's dead ones everywhere!
entries.zh: 到处都是死人！

entries.en: Goodbye.
entries.zh: 再见。

entries.en: I suppose we can try, but if things get bad I'm back to hiding.
entries.zh: 可以试试，可要是情况不妙，我就躲回去。

entries.en: Fine. But give us a chance before choosing flight.
entries.zh: 行。不过别急着逃，先试着一起撑住。

entries.en: That's all I ask.
entries.zh: 我只求这样。

entries.en: Alright.
entries.zh: 好吧。

entries.en: Good. Let's go.
entries.zh: 好，走吧。

entries.en: If I can't rely on you, then you're no use to me.
entries.zh: 如果不能指望你，那你对我就毫无用处。

entries.en: Good. I don't want to be.
entries.zh: 很好，我也不想派上用场。

entries.en: So be it.
entries.zh: 那就这样吧。

entries.en: I'm no fighter.
entries.zh: 我不会打架。

entries.en: Neither are these undead.
entries.zh: 这些亡者也不会。

entries.en: It doesn't take much. We can look for some weapons.
entries.zh: 用不着多大本事。我们可以找些武器。

entries.en: Nor am I, but the need is upon us.
entries.zh: 我也不会，可眼下别无选择。

entries.en: I will protect you. You'll be safe with me.
entries.zh: 我会保护你。跟着我很安全。

entries.en: I have no need for you then.
entries.zh: 那我就不需要你了。

entries.en: Good. You'll let me be then?
entries.zh: 那好，你肯放过我了吧？

entries.en: Of course. I wish you luck.
entries.zh: 当然。祝你好运。

entries.en: Do as you wish.
entries.zh: 随你的便。

entries.en: I can't let you go. You might attack me when I don't expect it.
entries.zh: 我不能放你走。你可能趁我不备攻击我。

entries.en:
No! Please!
I won't cause any trouble.
entries.zh:
不要！求你了！
我不会惹麻烦的。

entries.en: Fine. Stay away from me.
entries.zh: 好吧，离我远点。

entries.en: You must die.
entries.zh: 你必须死。

entries.en: We can handle these undead between us.
entries.zh: 我们两个能对付这些亡者。

entries.en: Don't worry about them, they seem placid.
entries.zh: 别担心它们，看起来挺平静的。

entries.en: They're not! One of them chased me!
entries.zh: 才不是！有一个追过我！

entries.en: Some may need dealing with.
entries.zh: 有些恐怕还是得解决掉。

entries.en: Looks like you got away just fine.
entries.zh: 看起来你逃得挺顺利。

entries.en: I can protect you, come.
entries.zh: 我能保护你，来吧。

entries.en: Why are you so scared? Find your courage.
entries.zh: 你为什么这么害怕？拿出点勇气。

entries.en: Bandits.
entries.zh: 强盗。

entries.en: Why would bandits throw you in here?
entries.zh: 强盗为什么把你扔在这里？

entries.en: I don't know. Everyone is mad all of a sudden.
entries.zh: 不知道，所有人突然都疯了。

entries.en: There may be something to it.
entries.zh: 这事可能有蹊跷。

entries.en: I didn't do nothing!
entries.zh: 我什么也没干！

entries.en:
I wasn't saying you did...
Let's just get out of here.
entries.zh:
我没说你做了什么……
我们还是先出去吧。

entries.en: No matter. I'll deal with them when I get out of here.
entries.zh: 算了，出去后我会对付他们。

entries.en: I guess they thought we wouldn't make it out. Let's prove them wrong.
entries.zh: 他们大概觉得我们出不去了，就让他们知道自己错了吧。

entries.en: I see. Perhaps just a cruel way to be rid of you.
entries.zh: 明白了。也许只是用这种残忍的办法除掉你。

entries.en: Seems the gods are against me today.
entries.zh: 看来今天诸神都在跟我作对。

entries.en: Well, let's get you out of here.
entries.zh: 那我们带你出去吧。

entries.en: The gods won't decide my fate. I'm leaving this place.
entries.zh: 诸神决定不了我的命运。我要离开这里。

entries.en: What?
entries.zh: 什么？

entries.en: Look, I don't know what's happening, I don't even know who I am.
entries.zh: 听着，我不知道发生了什么，甚至不知道自己是谁。

entries.en: You don't know who you are?
entries.zh: 你不知道自己是谁？

entries.en: I think my name is {Actor[1].Name}, but I don't really remember anything at all.
entries.zh: 我想我叫{Actor[1].Name}，可我真的什么都不记得。

entries.en: My name might be {Actor[1].Name}, but it sounds strange to me. I don't remember anything.
entries.zh: 我也许叫{Actor[1].Name}，但这个名字听起来很陌生。我什么都记不起。

entries.en: We need to get out of here.
entries.zh: 我们得离开这里。

entries.en: Please, help me leave this place.
entries.zh: 求你帮我离开这里。

entries.en: Let us work together, we'll have a better chance of making it through this.
entries.zh: 让我们联手吧，这样才更有希望活下去。

entries.en: Come with me, I doubt you'll survive this on your own.
entries.zh: 跟我走吧，你一个人恐怕活不下去。

entries.en: Leave me alone!
entries.zh: 别来烦我！

entries.en: Let me be!
entries.zh: 放过我吧！

entries.en: Get away from me!
entries.zh: 离我远点！

entries.en: Don't think I'll be much use, but I'll try to keep up.
entries.zh: 我可能帮不上什么忙，不过会尽量跟上的。

entries.en: Do you know how to fight?
entries.zh: 你会打架吗？

entries.en: My Da was a soldier, he tried to teach me some, but I wasn't much for it.
entries.zh: 我爹当过兵，想教过我一些，可我没怎么学进去。

entries.en: Hopefully we won't run into much trouble.
entries.zh: 希望我们不会遇上太多麻烦。

entries.en: Guess it's time to finally learn.
entries.zh: 看来是时候学一学了。

entries.en: Gods below, I hope I won't have need.
entries.zh: 地下诸神保佑，希望用不着。

entries.en: It's likely that you will.
entries.zh: 多半会用得着。

entries.en: Perhaps not.
entries.zh: 也许用不着。

entries.en: Don't worry, I can handle these undead.
entries.zh: 别担心，我能对付这些亡者。

entries.en: You can?
entries.zh: 你能？

entries.en: They are not much of a threat. Let's go.
entries.zh: 它们没多大威胁，走吧。

entries.en: I think so.
entries.zh: 我想是的。

entries.en: No matter, I can handle these undead.
entries.zh: 没关系，我能对付这些亡者。

entries.en: You can?
entries.zh: 你能？

entries.en: Of course. They are weak and clumsy.
entries.zh: 当然，它们又弱又笨拙。

entries.en: Well, probably.
entries.zh: 嗯，大概吧。

entries.en: That makes two of us. Together we should have a fighting chance.
entries.zh: 那我们彼此彼此。两个人总还能拼出一线生机。

entries.en: They don't seem very aggressive, I will try to avoid them.
entries.zh: 它们似乎不怎么主动攻击人，我会尽量避开。

entries.en: One of them chased me!
entries.zh: 有一个追过我！

entries.en: Sounds like you could use some help. Come with me.
entries.zh: 看来你需要帮忙，跟我走吧。

entries.en: So you're a coward.
entries.zh: 原来你是个胆小鬼。

entries.en: I'm just a farm hand with a stick! What was I to do?
entries.zh: 我只是个拿着棍子的农场帮工！还能怎么办？

entries.en: And you ran from something half dead with a stick. Pah.
entries.zh: 你拿着棍子，却被个半死的东西吓跑了。呸。

entries.en: It was vicious! I'm no fighter.
entries.zh: 它可凶了！我又不会打架。

entries.en: Well, you keep hiding. I'm going to find a way out of here.
entries.zh: 那你继续躲着吧，我要去找出口了。

entries.en: Good luck then.
entries.zh: 那祝你好运。

entries.en: Man up and come with me, the dead are of little threat.
entries.zh: 拿出点胆量跟我走，死人没什么可怕的。

entries.en: True enough. Come with me, I'll protect you.
entries.zh: 也是。跟我走吧，我会保护你。

entries.en: If there are undead, there must a necromancer.
entries.zh: 既然有亡者，就一定有死灵术士。

entries.en: There's a necromancer too?
entries.zh: 还有死灵术士？

entries.en: There has to be, and nearby. They must be sustained by one.
entries.zh: 一定有，而且就在附近。这些亡者需要术士维持。

entries.en: So what are we to do?
entries.zh: 那我们怎么办？

entries.en: Leave, of course. Come.
entries.zh: 当然是离开。来吧。

entries.en: I will find a way out.
entries.zh: 我会找到出口。

entries.en: What about me?
entries.zh: 那我呢？

entries.en: I suppose you can come with me.
entries.zh: 你可以跟我走。

entries.en: I don't know, it's not my concern.
entries.zh: 不知道，那不关我的事。

entries.en:
Oh. Alright then.
Good luck.
entries.zh:
哦，那好吧。
祝你好运。

entries.en: I said it in jest. Don't worry.
entries.zh: 我开玩笑的，别担心。

entries.en: I'm scared enough as it is.
entries.zh: 我已经够害怕了。

entries.en: Come with me, I'll get us out of here.
entries.zh: 跟我走，我会带我们出去。

entries.en:
Find your courage.
I must be going.
entries.zh:
鼓起勇气来。
我得走了。

entries.en: If you make it, will you send help?
entries.zh: 如果你出去了，会找人来救我吗？

entries.en: I'll try.
entries.zh: 我会尽力。

entries.en: Thank you.
entries.zh: 谢谢。

entries.en: Help yourself, man.
entries.zh: 自己救自己吧。

entries.en: If they get in my way, I will kill them.
entries.zh: 谁挡我的路，我就杀了谁。

entries.en: Please, take me with you!
entries.zh: 求你带我一起走！

entries.en: You may join me, if you wish.
entries.zh: 愿意的话，你可以加入我。

entries.en: No, you will only slow me down.
entries.zh: 不，你只会拖累我。

entries.en: Oh. Alright.
entries.zh: 哦，好吧。

entries.en: We should look around. My Da would say even a good shirt can save your skin.
entries.zh: 我们应该四处找找。我爹常说，哪怕一件好衬衫也能救命。

entries.en: Yes, we could use some weapons too.
entries.zh: 是啊，我们也需要些武器。

entries.en: Sure, let me know if you see anything useful.
entries.zh: 行，看到有用的东西就告诉我。

entries.en: Just take whatever you want.
entries.zh: 想拿什么就拿吧。

entries.en: Don't touch anything unless I say so.
entries.zh: 没有我的允许，什么都别碰。

entries.en: Derrin, I won't leave you on your own. Come with me.
entries.zh: 德林，我不会把你一个人留下。跟我走。

entries.en:
Yeah?
Thank you!
entries.zh:
真的？
谢谢你！

entries.en: I'm sure you'll make yourself useful.
entries.zh: 你一定能帮上忙的。

entries.en: No thanks needed. We're better of together.
entries.zh: 不用谢，待在一起更好。

entries.en: Let's go. Now.
entries.zh: 现在就走。

entries.en: Alright.
entries.zh: 好吧。

entries.en: Just leave me. Someone will come to help.
entries.zh: 别管我了，会有人来救我的。

entries.en: You really think someone will come find you?
entries.zh: 你真觉得会有人找到这里来？

entries.en:
Well...
I don't know.
entries.zh:
嗯……
我不知道。

entries.en: Don't leave your life to chance. Come.
entries.zh: 别把命交给运气，来吧。

entries.en: More likely you'll just find trouble.
entries.zh: 等来的更可能是麻烦。

entries.en: Alright. I'll come with you.
entries.zh: 好吧，我跟你走。

entries.en: Good. Let's go.
entries.zh: 好，走吧。

entries.en: Someone other than me?
entries.zh: 除了我，还会有谁？

entries.en: I don't mean it like that.
entries.zh: 我不是那个意思。

entries.en: You can trust me Derrin. Let's get out of here.
entries.zh: 你可以相信我，德林。我们出去吧。

entries.en: I'm here now. Come.
entries.zh: 我现在就在这里，来吧。

entries.en: Alright.
entries.zh: 好吧。

entries.en: Good. Let's go.
entries.zh: 好，走吧。

entries.en: Leave me alone!
entries.zh: 别来烦我！

entries.en: Derrin. I could use your help.
entries.zh: 德林，我需要你的帮助。

entries.en: Leave me alone!
entries.zh: 别来烦我！

entries.en: I'm no use, just leave me.
entries.zh: 我帮不上忙，别管我了。

entries.en: Together we can make it.
entries.zh: 我们一起就能做到。

entries.en: I don't know how much help I am, but I'll do my best.
entries.zh: 不知道能帮上多少忙，但我会尽力。

entries.en: I'm sure you'll make yourself useful.
entries.zh: 你一定能帮上忙的。

entries.en: Please!
entries.zh: 求你了！

entries.en: Stop!
entries.zh: 住手！

entries.en: No!
entries.zh: 不！

entries.en: Please!
entries.zh: 求你了！

entries.en: Please don't hurt me.
entries.zh: 求你别伤害我。

entries.en: You're a thaumer!
entries.zh: 你是个异能法师！

entries.en: A thaumer? It seems I have the basic talent.
entries.zh: 异能法师？我似乎是有点天赋。

entries.en: Well, I fancy our chances more now.
entries.zh: 那我觉得咱们的胜算大多了。

entries.en: I know very little, someone like me would not be admitted to the order.
entries.zh: 我所知甚少，像我这样的人是进不了教团的。

entries.en: My bindings are weak. I would be no match for the necromancer who did this.
entries.zh: 我的联结很弱，远不是造成这一切的死灵术士的对手。

entries.en: What can a necromancer do then?
entries.zh: 那死灵术士能做什么？

entries.en: Command the dead, turn us against each other, fill us with dread, or simply make us do their bidding.
entries.zh: 驱使死者，让我们自相残杀，使我们恐惧，或干脆让我们任其摆布。

entries.en: Right. That's why they're not liked much.
entries.zh: 对，所以大家都不太喜欢他们。

entries.en: A shaper of minds can do good. Give peace to those who won't find it of their own, dispel fears and bring harmony where there is discord. They can be healers of the mind.
entries.zh: 心智塑形者也能行善。让无法自行释怀的人获得安宁，驱散恐惧，化解纷争。他们可以医治心灵。

entries.en: People like healers alright, but don't like tinkering with their heads.
entries.zh: 人们是喜欢医师，可不喜欢有人乱动自己的脑子。

entries.en: Those who can heal the body can just as well do great harm.
entries.zh: 能医治身体的人，同样也能造成极大伤害。

entries.en: Well, that's not a healer then is it?
entries.zh: 那还算什么医师？

entries.en: You are right. And a mind shaper is not a necromancer.
entries.zh: 你说得对。所以心智塑形者也不等于死灵术士。

entries.en: It's all a bit beyond me, but thanks for explaining.
entries.zh: 我不太懂这些，不过谢谢你解释。

entries.en: Some will seek such "tinkering", but I will concede that point.
entries.zh: 有些人会主动寻求这种“干预”，不过你的说法也有道理。

entries.en: Best you don't know and hope we don't meet one.
entries.zh: 你最好别知道，也祈祷咱们碰不上吧。

entries.en: Oh I sure don't want to!
entries.zh: 我当然不想碰上！

entries.en: Only members of the order are thaumaturges.
entries.zh: 只有教团的成员才能称为异能术士。

entries.en: The order?
entries.zh: 教团？

entries.en: The Order of Thaumaturges. It's not like every dullard with a trick is a thaumaturge.
entries.zh: 异能术士教团。不是每个会耍点把戏的笨蛋都能叫异能术士。

entries.en: That's not just a trick!
entries.zh: 那可不只是把戏！

entries.en: Still, you must see my meaning.
entries.zh: 总之，你应该明白我的意思。

entries.en: If you're not a thaumer, what are you then?
entries.zh: 你不是异能法师，那你是什么？

entries.en: Would you call a hedge witch a "thaumer"?
entries.zh: 你会把乡野女巫叫作“异能法师”吗？

entries.en:
No?
That's not like what you did though.
entries.zh:
不会吧？
可那跟你刚才做的也不一样啊。

entries.en: Isn't it? I'm sure some take coin from the credulous, and some perhaps just know their herbs, but a true hedge witch has the talent.
entries.zh: 是吗？有些人或许只是骗取轻信者的钱财，有些只懂草药，但真正的乡野女巫是有天赋的。

entries.en: Alright, so what do you call someone who has this talent?
entries.zh: 那好，有这种天赋的人该叫什么？

entries.en: You must know of the Order of Thaumaturges!
entries.zh: 你总该听说过异能术士教团！

entries.en: Well, yeah, but I thought if you can do magics you're a thaumer.
entries.zh: 听说过，可我以为会魔法的都是异能法师。

entries.en: No. And we don't call it magic, or "thaumers".
entries.zh: 不是。而且我们不把它叫作魔法，也不说“异能法师”。

entries.en:
We?
So you are a thaumer!
entries.zh:
我们？
所以你就是异能法师！

entries.en: No. I couldn't be. Unless perhaps I've lost more than just my memories...
entries.zh: 不，我不可能是。除非我失去的不只是记忆……

entries.en: Some may not take kindly to your ignorance.
entries.zh: 有些人可不会容忍你这样无知。

entries.en: Sorry! I just don't know.
entries.zh: 对不起！我真的不懂。

entries.en: Someone with the talent would be called a shaper of bindings. Or just "shaper".
entries.zh: 有这种天赋的人称为联结塑形者，简称“塑形者”。

entries.en:
Shaper. Think I heard that before. Didn't know what it was.
Sorry for all the asking, always been a bit curious.
entries.zh:
塑形者。我好像听过，不知道是什么意思。
抱歉问了这么多，我一直有点好奇。

entries.en: It's alright.
entries.zh: 没关系。

entries.en: It is good to be inquisitive.
entries.zh: 勤于发问是好事。

entries.en: Let that be all.
entries.zh: 到此为止吧。

entries.en: I think I'm starting to like this.
entries.zh: 我好像开始喜欢上这些了。

entries.en: Like what?
entries.zh: 喜欢什么？

entries.en: All this, it's exciting, you know. The exploring, even the danger.
entries.zh: 这一切，很刺激，你知道吧。探索，甚至那些危险。

entries.en: So you're no longer scared?
entries.zh: 所以你不再害怕了？

entries.en: I'm still afeared, but maybe I'm not so weak as I thought.
entries.zh: 还是怕，可也许我没自己想的那么弱。

entries.en: That's good I guess, but keep your wits about you.
entries.zh: 这算好事吧，不过还是要保持警惕。

entries.en: I'll do that.
entries.zh: 我会的。

entries.en: You are weak, don't get overconfident.
entries.zh: 你很弱，别太自信。

entries.en: I'm not. I just never saw myself doing this, but I am.
entries.zh: 我没有，只是从没想过自己能做这些，可我做到了。

entries.en: Don't get too excited. The danger is real.
entries.zh: 别太兴奋，危险可是真的。

entries.en: Yeah, you're right.
entries.zh: 嗯，你说得对。

entries.en: These lamps, are they magic?
entries.zh: 这些灯是魔法做的吗？

entries.en: What do you mean by magic?
entries.zh: 你说的魔法是指什么？

entries.en: You know, the stuff thaumers do.
entries.zh: 就是异能法师弄的那些东西。

entries.en:
That would be a binding, and that's not how it works. You can't just create light or a force, it must be borrowed from somewhere.
This requires great concentration, and as soon you stop renewing the link, it breaks.
entries.zh:
那叫联结，但原理不是这样的。光和力都不能凭空产生，必须从别处借来。
这需要极度专注，一旦停止维持联系，联结就会断开。

entries.en: So you can't make a link that don't break?
entries.zh: 那就不能做个不会断的联系吗？

entries.en: A perpetual binding? It's nothing more than an idea, quite impossible.
entries.zh: 永续联结？那不过是个设想，根本不可能。

entries.en: A per... Never mind. But these dead ones then? What's binding them?
entries.zh: 永……算了。可那些死人呢？是什么联结着它们？

entries.en: That's a clever question. It's quite different, not impossible, but I didn't think it could be done. The dead control their bodies you see? Not the necromancer.
entries.zh: 问得聪明。那是另一回事，并非不可能，只是我没想到有人真能做到。明白吗？死者在操控自己的身体，而非死灵术士。

entries.en: I don't, but alright. So how do the lamps work then?
entries.zh: 不明白，不过算了。所以这些灯是怎么回事？

entries.en: I guess they must be alchemical.
entries.zh: 我想应该是炼金术的产物。

entries.en: But don't they only work for a time, then need turning over for a time?
entries.zh: 可那种灯不是亮一阵子，就得倒过来放一阵子吗？

entries.en: Well, yes, but I don't have a better answer. Perhaps it is a more clever mechanism.
entries.zh: 是，但我也没有更好的解释。或许是更巧妙的装置。

entries.en: Right. Sorry for all the asking.
entries.zh: 明白了，抱歉问了这么多。

entries.en: I really don't know.
entries.zh: 我真的不知道。

entries.en: Oh well.
entries.zh: 那好吧。

entries.en: That's different. Oh, I can't explain this to you, it's too complicated.
entries.zh: 那不一样。唉，我跟你解释不清，太复杂了。

entries.en: Fine.
entries.zh: 好吧。

entries.en: Didn't I just tell you that?
entries.zh: 我刚才不是说过了吗？

entries.en: I guess. I'm sorry, I'll shut up now.
entries.zh: 也是。抱歉，我不问了。

entries.en: Magic? Thaumers? I think it's best you don't concern yourself with such things.
entries.zh: 魔法？异能法师？我看你最好别操心这些。

entries.en: Sorry. I'm just curious.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我只是好奇。

entries.en:
Why are we going deeper?
I thought we were trying to get out.
entries.zh:
为什么越走越深了？
我以为我们是要出去。

entries.en: I'm looking for another way for us to get out.
entries.zh: 我正在给我们找另一条出路。

entries.en: I don't see that we have choice.
entries.zh: 我看我们别无选择。

entries.en: We shouldn't be here. It's not right.
entries.zh: 我们不该来这里，这不对劲。

entries.en: We can't just stand around and wait to die. We must search for an exit.
entries.zh: 我们总不能站着等死，必须找出口。

entries.en: I guess you're right. You seem so sure, but I have doubts.
entries.zh: 也许你是对的。你这么笃定，可我心里没底。

entries.en: It seems to me that you are more than a little curious.
entries.zh: 依我看，你的好奇心也不小。

entries.en:
Worried more like!
But I guess I am more curious than I'm wise.
entries.zh:
更多是担心吧！
不过我的好奇心大概确实比脑子好使。

entries.en: And yet curiosity is what leads us to wisdom.
entries.zh: 可正是好奇心引领我们获得智慧。

entries.en:
Clever that.
Alright, let's keep going.
entries.zh:
说得真妙。
好吧，继续走。

entries.en: We can't be sure, and yet we must act.
entries.zh: 即便无法确定，也必须行动。

entries.en: Fair enough.
entries.zh: 有道理。

entries.en: I will continue on. If you want to turn back, I will understand.
entries.zh: 我会继续向前。你想回去的话，我能理解。

entries.en: I'll stay with you. For now.
entries.zh: 我跟着你，暂时吧。

entries.en: If you think know better, you can find your own way.
entries.zh: 你觉得自己更懂，那就自己找路。

entries.en:
That's not what I meant.
I just have doubts.
entries.zh:
我不是那个意思。
只是有点疑虑。

entries.en: Derrin, clearly you are not just a farm hand. What are you hiding?
entries.zh: 德林，显然你不只是个农场帮工。你在隐瞒什么？

entries.en: What? Why would you think that?
entries.zh: 什么？你为什么这么想？

entries.en: You pretend you are ignorant, but sometimes you forget. You are too clever and literate.
entries.zh: 你假装无知，却偶尔会忘记伪装。你太聪明，也太有学识了。

entries.en: You're right. I don't need to hide this from you.
entries.zh: 你说得对，我没必要瞒着你。

entries.en: Clearly you are practiced in your deception, but I'm not easily fooled.
entries.zh: 看来你很擅长骗人，可我没那么容易上当。

entries.en: Alright. You're not the type I usually do this with, so I'll just stop.
entries.zh: 好吧，你不是我平时糊弄的那种人，我不装了。

entries.en: Never mind.
entries.zh: 算了。

entries.en: I am farm hand, but I'm also lord Ermus' man. I keep an eye on things and let him know what I see.
entries.zh: 我是农场帮工，但也是厄穆斯领主的人。我留意周围的事，把看到的告诉他。

entries.en: So you're a spy?
entries.zh: 所以你是个密探？

entries.en:
A spy? No!
I guess, sometimes. People act normal near me, I hear things, they tell me things.
entries.zh:
密探？不是！
有时候也算吧。人们在我身边很自在，我能听到消息，他们也愿意告诉我事情。

entries.en: So who are you really? I'm not sure I understand.
entries.zh: 所以你究竟是谁？我还是不太明白。

entries.en: I worked in Ermus' father's orchards when I was little. Ermus and I became friends. We still are, we have long talks. I tell him things, he teaches me things.
entries.zh: 小时候，我在厄穆斯父亲的果园里干活。我和厄穆斯成了朋友，现在也是，我们常长谈。我告诉他见闻，他教我知识。

entries.en: Interesting. Lord Ermus sounds like a singular man.
entries.zh: 有意思，厄穆斯领主听起来是个不寻常的人。

entries.en: Yes, I guess he is. I'm glad for it.
entries.zh: 嗯，他是。我很庆幸。

entries.en: Well, thanks for clearing that up. I have better measure of you now.
entries.zh: 谢谢你说明白，现在我更了解你了。

entries.en: And does you being here have something to do with all this?
entries.zh: 那你被困在这里，也和这些事有关吗？

entries.en: That sounds like a lonely and difficult life.
entries.zh: 听起来是种孤独又艰难的生活。

entries.en: I have friends! And my Ma. Okay, Well, Ermus is the friend I care about, that's why I do it.
entries.zh: 我有朋友！还有我娘。好吧，我最在意的朋友是厄穆斯，所以才为他做这些。

entries.en: You and Lord Ermus are friends? That seems odd.
entries.zh: 你和厄穆斯领主是朋友？这可真少见。

entries.en: I worked in his father's orchards as a lad, and we became friends. We still meet, in secret. I tell him what he doesn't see in his lands, he teaches me things, gives me books.
entries.zh: 小时候我在他父亲的果园里干活，我们成了朋友。如今还会秘密见面。我告诉他领地上他看不到的事，他教我知识，给我书。

entries.en: What a peculiar arrangement. Thanks for explaining, I have a better measure of you now.
entries.zh: 真是特别的关系。谢谢你的解释，我现在更了解你了。

entries.en: I see. Does your being here have something to do with all this?
entries.zh: 明白了。你被困在这里，和这些事有关吗？

entries.en:
In truth I thought I could find the bandits and report what I saw.
I did, and they found me. And so here I am.
entries.zh:
其实我想找到那些强盗，把看到的汇报上去。
我找到了他们，他们也发现了我，所以我就到这儿了。

entries.en: I think that's all I need to know. This doesn't concern me.
entries.zh: 我知道这些就够了，这不关我的事。

entries.en: I suppose not. I'm just in the habit of keeping it secret.
entries.zh: 也是，我只是习惯了保密。

entries.en: Well, I wanted to help, so I tried to find the bandits.
entries.zh: 我想帮点忙，就试着去找那些强盗。

entries.en: And so they found you, and here you are.
entries.zh: 于是他们发现了你，你就到了这里。

entries.en: I take it this is not your usual purview.
entries.zh: 想必这不在你平时的职责之内。

entries.en: Yeah, not my best idea. But we lost so many, I wanted to do something.
entries.zh: 对，这主意不太好。可是我们失踪了那么多人，我想做点什么。

entries.en: I suppose you did find them after all.
entries.zh: 至少你确实找到他们了。

entries.en: Oh, I'm not the first I don't think, but the others didn't do too good either.
entries.zh: 我应该不是第一个去找的人，可其他人也没好到哪里去。

entries.en: We're not dead yet. We may fair better still.
entries.zh: 我们还没死，也许最终会好起来。

entries.en: It's admirable I guess, but still stupid.
entries.zh: 勇气可嘉，不过还是很蠢。

entries.en: Well, that's me.
entries.zh: 嗯，我就这样。

entries.en: Right, let's get you ouf of here so you can make more bad decisions.
entries.zh: 好吧，先带你出去，好让你再犯些蠢。

entries.en: We don't know what clever thing you did to get stuck here.
entries.zh: 还不知道你干了什么聪明事，才被困在这里呢。

entries.en: Yeah, clearly it was not.
entries.zh: 是啊，显然不是什么聪明事。

entries.en: Maybe you should find out how you got yourself here before you mock me.
entries.zh: 你还是先弄清自己怎么进来的，再来笑我吧。

entries.en: Fair point. Let's turn our thoughts to getting out of here.
entries.zh: 说得对，还是想想怎么出去吧。

entries.en: Nothing so stupid, I'm sure. But enough of this.
entries.zh: 肯定没这么蠢。好了，不说了。

entries.en: What's that?!
entries.zh: 那是什么？！

entries.en: That must be a portal. A doorway to another place.
entries.zh: 那一定是传送门，通往另一个地方的门户。

entries.en: I know what that is, it's a gateway to hell!
entries.zh: 我知道那是什么，那是地狱之门！

entries.en: Don't talk nonsense Derrin.
entries.zh: 别胡说，德林。

entries.en: It's not nonsense! This is the underworld. The dead are risen. We go into the hells!
entries.zh: 才不是胡说！这里就是冥界，死人都复活了，我们在走向地狱！

entries.en: Religious claptrap. There's no such thing as the hells, this is just a means of travel.
entries.zh: 宗教的胡言乱语。根本没有什么地狱，这只是种旅行方式。

entries.en: How could you know?
entries.zh: 你怎么知道？

entries.en: There are ancient, and forbidden, texts that talk of such things.
entries.zh: 有些古老的禁书记载过这些东西。

entries.en: Forbidden? Why? By whom?
entries.zh: 禁书？为什么？谁禁的？

entries.en: Ardent, the powers that be. They don't want us down here, for a start, but the true reason I don't know.
entries.zh: 阿登的当权者。他们本来就不想让我们来到地下，但真正原因我也不知道。

entries.en: Maybe because it's dangerous?
entries.zh: 也许因为这里危险？

entries.en: The dangers we face have naught to do with your superstitions.
entries.zh: 我们面对的危险，与你的迷信毫无关系。

entries.en: By people who grow tired of farm hands asking too many questions.
entries.zh: 被那些受够了农场帮工没完没了提问的人禁止的。

entries.en:
Ha.
Well, reckon I might not get another chance.
entries.zh:
哈。
好吧，怕是以后再没机会问了。

entries.en: What imminent peril do you imagine now?
entries.zh: 你又想象出什么迫在眉睫的危险了？

entries.en: I've studied such things. You must trust me.
entries.zh: 我研究过这些，你必须相信我。

entries.en: Everyone knows of the underworld!
entries.zh: 人人都知道冥界！

entries.en: Superstitions are not knowledge.
entries.zh: 迷信不等于知识。

entries.en: We're under ground, and there is necromancy at work. Don't let your imagination carry you too far.
entries.zh: 我们在地下，这里有人施展死灵术。别任由自己胡思乱想。

entries.en:
You pretend you don't know!
It is plain. Tell me it isn't so.
entries.zh:
你装作不知道！
这不是明摆着吗？你倒说说不是这么回事。

entries.en: I say the simple truth as I see it. You are too hasty in your assumptions.
entries.zh: 我只是说出眼中的事实，你的判断太草率了。

entries.en: I see why you think as you do, but think also of the truth in what I say.
entries.zh: 我明白你为什么这样想，但也该想想我说的话有什么道理。

entries.en: You're just saying all that so I won't be feared.
entries.zh: 你说这些只是为了让我别害怕。

entries.en: No. It is plain to me that this does not lead to the hells.
entries.zh: 不，我很清楚这里并不通往地狱。

entries.en: I care little how you feel, only for what is real and true. Wherever this gateway leads, it is not to the hells.
entries.zh: 我不怎么在乎你的感受，只在乎事实。无论这道门通往哪里，都不是地狱。

entries.en: Do you truly believe such things?
entries.zh: 你真相信这些？

entries.en:
Well, I hadn't given it thought. But look!
We are deep below ground, the dead are risen and there are such things as this!
entries.zh:
以前没仔细想过，可你看看！
我们深入地下，死人复活，还有这样的东西！

entries.en: You speak of the underworld, but It is just an ancient place, below the ground.
entries.zh: 你说是冥界，可它只是个地下的古老地方。

entries.en:
You're not listening!
This isn't just some place.
entries.zh:
你根本没听进去！
这可不是普通的地方。

entries.en: Old ruins, necromancy and strange ancient things. The rest is fancy.
entries.zh: 古老遗迹、死灵术和奇异的古代造物，其他都是想象。

entries.en: Of course it is.
entries.zh: 它当然就是个普通地方。

entries.en: Look around, clearly this wasn't put here to descend into the hells.
entries.zh: 看看四周，这东西显然不是为了下地狱而造的。

entries.en: This is the underworld! The ancients went places they shouldn't have. Everyone knows this!
entries.zh: 这里就是冥界！古人去了不该去的地方，谁都知道！

entries.en: There may be some truth to that, but this is no gateway to hell.
entries.zh: 也许有几分道理，但这不是地狱之门。

entries.en: Demons could come out right now!
entries.zh: 恶魔随时都可能从里面出来！

entries.en: This has been here a very long time, yet there are no demons.
entries.zh: 这东西在这里已经很久了，却没有恶魔。

entries.en: We just didn't see any.
entries.zh: 只是我们没看见。

entries.en: Demons do not live under ground.
entries.zh: 恶魔不住在地下。

entries.en: Now you're saying demons aren't real?
entries.zh: 现在你又说恶魔不存在了？

entries.en: No, but they come from the demonic planes, not a hole in the ground.
entries.zh: 不，但它们来自恶魔位面，不是地上的洞。

entries.en: It's all the same, the hells below the underworld.
entries.zh: 都一样，地狱就在冥界之下。

entries.en: The planes have open skies, if the demonologists are to be believed.
entries.zh: 如果恶魔学者的话可信，那些位面上有开阔的天空。

entries.en: That doesn't sound right.
entries.zh: 听起来不对吧。

entries.en: Not the same. The hells don't even make sense.
entries.zh: 不一样，地狱这种说法本身就没道理。

entries.en: Like any of this makes sense.
entries.zh: 说得好像眼下这些事有道理似的。

entries.en: I don't deny that demons are real, but it's not likely you'll find them here.
entries.zh: 我没否认恶魔存在，只是这里不太可能有。

entries.en: You're just pretending like you don't know where we are.
entries.zh: 你就是装作不知道我们在哪里。

entries.en: Where we are is just not what you think it is.
entries.zh: 只是我们所在的地方与你想的不同。

entries.en: You're talking about things you don't understand.
entries.zh: 你说的都是自己不懂的事。

entries.en: I don't know much, but I can see what's in front of me.
entries.zh: 我懂得不多，但我看得到眼前的东西。

entries.en: There's no such thing as demons.
entries.zh: 世上根本没有恶魔。

entries.en: You're lying!
entries.zh: 你骗人！

entries.en:
Demons!
I told you!
entries.zh:
恶魔！
我早说过！

entries.en:
Gods below, that... 
That monster!
entries.zh:
地下诸神啊，那……
那个怪物！

entries.en: That... That was Marlia!
entries.zh: 那……那是玛莉娅！

entries.en: What do you mean?
entries.zh: 你什么意思？

entries.en:
That dead one, I knew her. It was Marlia.
For a moment I thought she recognised me too.
entries.zh:
那个死人，我认识她，是玛莉娅。
有一瞬间，我觉得她也认出了我。

entries.en: Did you know her well?
entries.zh: 你和她很熟吗？

entries.en: Not really, she served at the Fallen Oak. We talked a few times.
entries.zh: 不算，她在倒橡树酒馆做侍者。我们聊过几次。

entries.en: I'm sorry. That must be awful to see.
entries.zh: 真遗憾，看到这些一定很难受。

entries.en: Well, she won't be doing that anymore.
entries.zh: 那她以后可干不了了。

entries.en: What a horrible thing to say!
entries.zh: 你怎么能说这种话！

entries.en: She didn't look too good, I think you could do better.
entries.zh: 她看起来不怎么样，我觉得你能找个更好的。

entries.en: What? You're vile! It wasn't like that, I just knew her is all.
entries.zh: 什么？你真恶心！不是你想的那样，我只是认识她！

entries.en: I'm sorry. I was trying to lighten the mood.
entries.zh: 抱歉，我只是想缓和一下气氛。

entries.en: Calm down, it was just a joke.
entries.zh: 冷静点，只是个玩笑。

entries.en: You better toughen up and ignore it, might not be the last one you recognise.
entries.zh: 你最好坚强点，别在意。她可能不是你认出的最后一个。

entries.en:
Gods below, I guess you're right.
I thought I knew some others, but with her I was sure.
entries.zh:
地下诸神啊，你说得对。
我觉得其他几个也有些眼熟，但她我是认准了。

entries.en: So if you can't even remember who you are, how do you know all this stuff?
entries.zh: 你连自己是谁都不记得，怎么还知道这么多？

entries.en: I'm not sure, it just sort of comes to me. I know things, objects, ideas, but I don't recall myself doing anything before now.
entries.zh: 我也不清楚，知识就这么浮现出来。我认识事物、物品和概念，却想不起在此之前自己做过任何事。

entries.en: Nothing at all? That must feel right strange. I'd be scared I think.
entries.zh: 一点都没有？那感觉肯定很怪，换我会害怕的。

entries.en: Sometimes I think I remember something, but it's confused, like a dream. And I'm not really me. I can't explain it.
entries.zh: 有时觉得自己记起了什么，可又很模糊，像梦一样。而且我又不真的是我自己，说不清楚。

entries.en: I admit It is quite frightening. Sometimes I look at my hands and think "who is this person?"
entries.zh: 确实很可怕。有时我看着自己的手，会想“这人是谁？”

entries.en: Not everyone is as ignorant as you are, Derrin.
entries.zh: 不是所有人都像你这么无知，德林。

entries.en:
Sure, this is normal stuff people know.
You're an arse.
entries.zh:
是啊，这些都是普通人知道的常识。
你真是个混蛋。

entries.en: I just do.
entries.zh: 我就是知道。

entries.en:
Right.
Sorry I asked.
entries.zh:
好吧。
抱歉多问了。

entries.en: What's that strange smell?
entries.zh: 那股怪味是什么？

entries.en: I don't know. Hopefully it won't give ailment.
entries.zh: 不知道，希望不会让人生病。

entries.en: You know, it makes me think of when you uncover an ant nest, when working the soil.
entries.zh: 你知道吗，这让我想起翻土时挖开蚁穴的味道。

entries.en: Interesting. I'm not familiar with that smell.
entries.zh: 有意思，我没闻过那种气味。

entries.en: I doubt there is a connection.
entries.zh: 我觉得两者没什么关系。

entries.en: Yeah, it's just similar is all.
entries.zh: 是啊，只是有点像。

entries.en:
Oh, I don't like this.
Please let's leave this place.
entries.zh:
哦，我不喜欢这里。
求你了，离开这个地方吧。

entries.en: What's wrong?
entries.zh: 怎么了？

entries.en: A memory I think. It scared me.
entries.zh: 我想是一段记忆，吓到我了。

entries.en: What was it of?
entries.zh: 是什么记忆？

entries.en: I don't know, it was really just a feeling.
entries.zh: 不知道，其实只是一种感觉。

entries.en: I wonder what happened to you.
entries.zh: 不知道你以前经历了什么。

entries.en: Perhaps in time I will remember.
entries.zh: 也许慢慢会想起来。

entries.en: I couldn't say, it flees my mind like a dream upon waking.
entries.zh: 说不清，它像醒来后的梦一样迅速消散。

entries.en: Maybe you'll start to remember things.
entries.zh: 也许你会开始想起一些事。

entries.en: We shall see.
entries.zh: 再看看吧。

entries.en: Nothing. Just a headache.
entries.zh: 没什么，只是头疼。

entries.en: It must be bad.
entries.zh: 一定很严重吧。

entries.en: Just surprised me. It's gone now.
entries.zh: 只是吓了我一跳，现在没事了。

entries.en: Alright.
entries.zh: 好吧。

entries.en: Are you alright?
entries.zh: 你没事吧？

entries.en: I'm fine. I think I've been here before.
entries.zh: 我没事，感觉以前来过这里。

entries.en: Do you remember something?
entries.zh: 你想起什么了吗？

entries.en: Still nothing. I feel as though I should, but my mind goes blank.
entries.zh: 还是没有。感觉本该想起些什么，脑子里却一片空白。

entries.en: I'm sure it will come back to you.
entries.zh: 你一定会想起来的。

entries.en: I'm starting to think I may not want it to. I feel the memories would not be pleasant.
entries.zh: 我开始觉得，也许自己并不想记起来。那些记忆恐怕并不愉快。

entries.en: No. This place just feels familiar.
entries.zh: 没有，只是觉得这里很熟悉。

entries.en: Looks like someone's been here.
entries.zh: 看起来有人来过。

entries.en: Yes.
entries.zh: 是。

entries.en: Yes. Just let me be.
entries.zh: 是，让我静一静。

entries.en: Alright.
entries.zh: 好吧。

entries.en: It happened again?
entries.zh: 又出现了？

entries.en: Yeah. The same feeling.
entries.zh: 嗯，一样的感觉。

entries.en: You still don't remember anything at all?
entries.zh: 你还是什么都记不起来吗？

entries.en: No. But something is changing. I feel stronger, in some way more like myself. Whoever that is.
entries.zh: 是，但有什么正在改变。我变强了，某种程度上更像真正的自己，无论那是谁。

entries.en: That's good, I suppose.
entries.zh: 那应该是好事吧。

entries.en: I fear I may not like who I am.
entries.zh: 我怕自己不会喜欢原本的那个人。

entries.en: I reckon you decide who you want to be.
entries.zh: 我觉得你可以自己决定想成为什么人。

entries.en: I'll need my strength at least. I think more challenges lie ahead of us.
entries.zh: 至少我需要力量，我想前面还有更多挑战等着我们。

entries.en:
Not much I hope.
Good you're feeling stronger though.
entries.zh:
希望别有太多。
不过你感觉变强了，终归是好事。

entries.en: Just a little. I feel I can do more.
entries.zh: 好了一点，感觉自己能做得更多。

entries.en: Head hurts again?
entries.zh: 又头疼了？

entries.en: It's more as though I'm trying to remember something, but I can't, and it pains me.
entries.zh: 更像是努力回忆什么，却又想不起来，这让我很痛苦。

entries.en: That sounds rough.
entries.zh: 听着挺难熬的。

entries.en: It's not so bad. It passes quickly.
entries.zh: 没那么严重，很快就过去了。

entries.en: Yeah. It's nothing, don't worry about.
entries.zh: 嗯，没什么，别担心。

entries.en: Alright.
entries.zh: 好吧。

entries.en: Derrin, we must enter the portal.
entries.zh: 德林，我们必须进入传送门。

entries.en: Through here might well be our exit.
entries.zh: 这道门后面说不定就是出口。

entries.en:
You're mad!
We're not doing that!
entries.zh:
你疯了！
我们不能这么干！

entries.en: It's like a door, there's nothing to fear.
entries.zh: 就像一扇门，没什么好怕的。

entries.en: I can see what's past a door, and it's not often the stuff of nightmares.
entries.zh: 我看得见普通门后有什么，那通常也不会是噩梦里的东西。

entries.en: It is the only way forward.
entries.zh: 这是唯一能继续前进的路。

entries.en: Then it's time to go back.
entries.zh: 那就该回头了。

entries.en: Let's see what's on the other side, we can always come back.
entries.zh: 去看看另一边有什么，我们随时能回来。

entries.en: What if we can't? What if we die?
entries.zh: 要是回不来呢？死了怎么办？

entries.en: Let's not do this again. We have no choice.
entries.zh: 别再争了，我们别无选择。

entries.en: I'm as mad as you are to follow you.
entries.zh: 跟着你，我也一样疯了。

entries.en: We make a good team then.
entries.zh: 那我们还真是好搭档。

entries.en: How about you go in, and if you don't come back I'll know.
entries.zh: 不如你先进去，你要是不回来，我就知道结果了。

entries.en:
That's not funny!
You're going in first.
entries.zh:
一点也不好笑！
你先进去。

entries.en: Ha. So you will follow.
entries.zh: 哈，这么说你还是会跟来。

entries.en: Damn you!
entries.zh: 你这个混蛋！

entries.en: Follow.
entries.zh: 跟上。

entries.en: Wait.
entries.zh: 等着。
